note: #528 is the follow-up to #526. It records AdminDocs.tsx only. The save acknowledgement listener now gives up after 10 seconds when no server snapshot arrives, so a note cannot stay on Saving until reconnect. The digest below is appended beside #526's; nothing already recorded is replaced.

entries.why: #528 owns this follow-up to #526's save acknowledgement, appended beside that digest and not in place of it. saveDoc waits for this commit's server snapshot on an onSnapshot listener with includeMetadataChanges until hasPendingWrites clears. That wait had no bound, so a write the server had already accepted could leave the chip on Saving until the tab reconnected and a snapshot finally arrived. The listener now unsubscribes after 10 seconds and resolves with no timestamp, which is the existing path that drops the remembered copy so a later server row can win. A snapshot already in flight when the listener is removed is ignored, because settled is set before unsubscribe. The timer is cleared on the acknowledgement, on the timeout, on a listener error and on a rejected write, so the listener does not stay attached. closeEditor, the title blur, the unmount flush, the delete-cancels-not-flushes rule, the share flows, the menu and the toolbar are unchanged.
